attributes.name: Color Tree
attributes.summary:
An exploratory study of color perception, after John Maeda. Color Tree renders the Munsell color system — the century-old standard that describes any color by hue, value (lightness), and chroma (intensity), written like 5G 5/8 — as a living 3D solid you can tumble, slice, and read page by page. Because Albert Munsell measured real human perception, the solid is not a neat sphere: every hue reaches its peak intensity at its own lightness, so the model grows into a lopsided tree. Press TO ITTEN to morph it into the perfect sphere that Bauhaus color theorist Johannes Itten imagined instead, and see exactly where the idealized model bends the truth.

It is first a learning device — for humans and for AI agents — and second a picker for when a flat color wheel is not enough: compare two brand accents at equal lightness, find the most saturated teal that still reads on a dark background, or teach why yellow feels lighter than purple. Open the demo, drag to tumble the tree, slice it by hue or value, open the atlas to leaf through the color pages, and (with the atlas open) hold any chip to copy its hex — your pick is saved on the card together with its Munsell notation. Turn on SOUND for the ambient audio layer: a quiet room tone whose filter opens with chroma and proximity, a glissando on the morph, and a tenor voice that tracks the open atlas page.

## What an AI can reuse from this implementation

- **Perceptual color math** (`utils/munsell`): `maxChroma` encodes the lopsided-canopy rule (each hue's peak chroma at its own value), `chipHex`/`munsellNotation` convert Munsell coordinates to sRGB hex and notation, and `buildArrays` bakes dual position sets (tree and sphere) into one lattice for GPU morphing.
- **WebGL patterns** (`utils/tree-engine`): a single `TreeEngine` owning shared shader uniforms driven by spring targets, analytic screen→page picking with no raycaster, and a scissor-rendered scout miniature in the same canvas.
- **GLSL morphing** (`utils/shaders`): a three-address vertex morph (tree ↔ sphere ↔ flattened atlas page) blended by two uniforms.
- **WebAudio sound design** (`components/color-tree-isolated`): an ambient bed (filtered-noise room tone + sine pad with LFO) modulated by UI state, plus event voices (morph glissando, atlas slice voice, copy chime) — a compact template for giving any card a sonic layer.

Discovery terms: color picker, Munsell, Itten, color theory, color wheel, 3D color space, hue value chroma, color visualization, perceptual color.
